_note: Query 7: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-03-05,End=2026-05-06 --granularity DAILY --metrics AmortizedCost UnblendedCost --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=RECORD_TYPE (no filter). Both views of the same bill. Usage + SavingsPlanCoveredUsage are the usage record types (they equal the sum of billing-data.json for the day). Everything else is non-usage: SavingsPlanRecurringFee (Unblended: the hourly commitment of the m5 and r5 plans; Amortized: UNUSED commitment only - here the all-upfront SageMaker plan, 9000/365 = 24.66 per day, since no SageMaker usage appears in the account), SavingsPlanNegation (Unblended only; cancels the on-demand value of covered usage), SavingsPlanUpfrontFee (Unblended: 9000.00 on 2026-04-21, one day; Amortized: 0.00 because the cost is spread), Support. Summed over all record types, Unblended and Amortized differ only by the upfront payment not yet amortized. Estimated days (05-04, 05-05) are partial.
